limitations: r33 has not been run. Kinsect, poison, blast and mount detection come from static research of MHGU 1.4.0 code without a gameplay trace.
The mount number is taken from the fixed HP subtraction in ride state 0xd; identifying it as the mount finisher is an inference from the surrounding ride code.
Poison, blast and mount numbers have no owner and appear for every player at the monster root position.
Show other damage cannot attribute its numbers: online it includes other hunters, and it includes traps, cannons and environmental damage.
r30 has not yet been run on the affected devices; if the native applied crop is unavailable or invalid, the mod retains Forge display bounds.
The existing camera-admission policy still cannot prove presentation ownership of a same-aspect offscreen camera.
